panels.description: Comparaison lisible des modèles: MAE et RMSE en jours. Plus petit = meilleur. Les filtres Top 3 modèles - étape et modèle s’appliquent seulement à cette section.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  CONCAT(
    CASE
      WHEN stage_prediction = 'avancee' THEN 'Avancée'
      WHEN stage_prediction = 'intermediaire' THEN 'Intermédiaire'
      WHEN stage_prediction = 'precoce' THEN 'Précoce'
      ELSE COALESCE(stage_prediction, 'Inconnu')
    END,
    ' • #', rang_modele,
    ' • ',
    CASE
      WHEN model_name = 'XGBoostRegressor' THEN 'XGBoost'
      WHEN model_name = 'RandomForestRegressor' THEN 'RandomForest'
      WHEN model_name = 'LinearRegression' THEN 'Linear'
      WHEN model_name = 'GradientBoostingRegressor' THEN 'GradientBoost'
      WHEN model_name = 'ExtraTreesRegressor' THEN 'ExtraTrees'
      ELSE COALESCE(model_name, 'Inconnu')
    END
  ) AS modele_etape,
  ROUND(holdout_mae, 2) AS MAE,
  ROUND(holdout_rmse, 2) AS RMSE
FROM vue_pred_section7_top3_modeles
WHERE
  COALESCE(stage_prediction, 'Inconnu') LIKE ${top3_etape:sqlstring}
  AND COALESCE(model_name, '') LIKE ${top3_modele:sqlstring}
ORDER BY stage_prediction, rang_modele;
